answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in mirror, verified in dawn, and mesa names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 9 submissions per epoch. The attacker spends 209 dollars and 1 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
